scope: R78 fixed-checkpoint finite support audit and matched second-unit mechanism permutations; no new training, language model, biological data, or phenomenal measurement

definitions.natural_support: the four hidden vectors produced by the declared four-input domain at a fixed checkpoint
definitions.coordinate_product: the Cartesian product of the separately observed values of hidden units 1 and 2
definitions.label_preserving_permutation: a reassignment of unit-2 activations across input rows that preserves both target classes and hence unit-2 target-conditional marginals
